fields.value: Prompt, Calm Care When You Need It Most

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Dental emergencies can be painful, worrying and disruptive. Whether you have woken with a throbbing toothache, cracked a tooth on something hard or had a knock during sport, our team is here to help. We set aside time each day for urgent appointments and will do our best to see you on the day you call.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Our priority at an emergency visit is to relieve your discomfort, find the cause of the problem and stabilise the tooth or area. Once you are comfortable, we explain what we found and talk you through the options for ongoing treatment.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Counts as a Dental Emergency?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A dental emergency is any problem that causes significant pain, bleeding, swelling or damage that needs prompt attention. Common examples include:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Severe or persistent toothache

fields.label: List item
fields.value: A broken, chipped or cracked tooth

fields.label: List item
fields.value: A tooth that has been knocked out or pushed out of position

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Swelling of the face, gums or jaw, which may indicate an abscess

fields.label: List item
fields.value: A lost filling, crown, inlay or onlay

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Injuries to the lips, cheeks, tongue or gums

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If you are unsure whether your situation is urgent, please call us. Our team will ask a few questions and help you decide on the next step.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: When to Go to Hospital

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Some situations need immediate hospital care. If you have facial swelling affecting your breathing or swallowing, bleeding that will not stop with firm pressure, a suspected jaw fracture or a head injury, call 000 or go to your nearest hospital emergency department.

sections.label: What to Do While You Wait

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What to Do While You Wait

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Stay calm and call us as early in the day as possible. Rinse gently with warm water, use a cold compress on the outside of your face to help with swelling, and take over-the-counter pain relief as directed on the packaging if it is suitable for you. Avoid placing aspirin directly on the gums, as this can irritate soft tissue.

sections.label: What Happens at Your Emergency Appointment

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Happens at Your Emergency Appointment

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: When you arrive, we will ask about your symptoms and medical history. We then examine the area and take digital X-rays if needed to understand what is happening beneath the surface. Once we have a clear picture, we explain our findings and focus on relieving your pain. This may involve smoothing a sharp edge, placing a temporary filling, draining an infection, beginning root canal therapy or protecting a damaged tooth. If further treatment is needed, we will talk through your options and costs before booking a follow-up.

sections.label: Why Choose Precision Dental for Emergency Care

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Why Choose Precision Dental for Emergency Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Our Fortitude Valley practice is centrally located with free on-site parking, which can make a stressful day a little easier. We use digital X-rays and an intra-oral camera to diagnose quickly and clearly, and we offer happy gas for patients who feel anxious. With appointments from 8am on Fridays and until 7pm on Tuesdays, we can often find a time that works for you.

sections.label: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The cost of your treatment depends on your individual needs. After your examination, we talk you through your options and the expected fees before any treatment begins. We accept most major health funds, process claims on the spot through HICAPS and are a preferred provider for {{site:preferredFunds}}. Interest-free payment plans are available through DentiCare for eligible patients, subject to terms and conditions. You can learn more on our Prices and Payment Options page.

fields.label: Small label
fields.value: FAQ

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Frequently Asked Questions

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can I get a same-day emergency appointment?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We keep time available for urgent care and will do our best to see you on the day you call. Calling early in the day gives us the best chance of finding a suitable time.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: What should I do if my tooth is knocked out?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Pick the tooth up by the crown, not the root, and gently rinse it with milk if it is dirty. If you can, place it back into the socket and bite on a clean cloth, or keep it in milk, and call us immediately.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Should I go to the dentist or the hospital?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: For most tooth pain, breaks and lost restorations, a dentist is the right place to start. If you have swelling affecting your breathing or swallowing, uncontrolled bleeding, a jaw fracture or a head injury, go to a hospital emergency department.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can I wait until Monday to see a dentist?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Some problems can be managed for a short time, but pain, swelling and damage often worsen without treatment. Please call us for advice, as early care may help avoid more involved treatment later.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Do you treat children in an emergency?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Yes. We see children for dental injuries and pain, and we take extra care to keep them calm and comfortable. Bring your child in as soon as possible after an injury.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: How much does an emergency appointment cost?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The cost depends on the examination, any X-rays and the treatment required. We will explain the expected fees before we begin, and we process health fund claims on the spot through HICAPS.
